People: Pietro Martire Vermigli (author, Wikidata Q598060), died 1562; Heinrich Bullinger (author, Wikidata Q123839), died 1575; Thomas Becon (translator, Wikidata Q7787508), died 1567. They are every person Project Gutenberg's catalog lists for the book ("Vermigli, Pietro Martire, 1499-1562; Bullinger, Heinrich, 1504-1575; Becon, Thomas, 1512-1567 [Translator]") and every person the printed edition's opening pages credit; each death year is Wikidata's.

Printed edition: A Treatise of the Cohabitacyon of the Faithfull...  1555, 1555, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/bim_early-english-books-1475-1640_a-treatise-of-the-cohabi_treatise_1555. Three passages of the Gutenberg text have 43%, 70%, 51% of their four-word runs in the scan's text. The scan does not show the credit of Pietro Martire Vermigli, Heinrich Bullinger, Thomas Becon, whom the catalog lists; the passages show the scan holds this text.
